# Extractor test fixtures

Synthetic HTML pages the extractor's parsers are tested against.

## The rule: structure only

Each file copies the **structure** of a real Guild Wars Wiki page — its tags,
classes, table layout and link shapes, as recorded in
[T2.1](../../../../docs/findings/T2.1-extractor-spike.md) §3 — and nothing
else:

- every number is invented;
- all prose is placeholder text ("Lorem skill text");
- skill and page titles are either invented ("Lorem Surge") or real titles,
  which are facts.

No wiki content is committed here (DESIGN §8.10, §9.5). Real pages live only
in the git-ignored `.cache/`, and the tests that read them are `#[ignore]`d.

## The files

| File | Copies | Edge case it exercises |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skill_basic.html` | a caster skill page | elite, `¾` activation, two scaled rows, target/range/AoE categories |
| `skill_split_pve.html` | the PvE half of a split skill | `PvE versions of skills`; a 21-column progression table |
| `skill_title.html` | a PvE-only title skill | no profession, `Asura rank` attribute, 11 title-rank columns |
| `skill_adrenaline.html` | an adrenal attack skill | adrenaline cost, no activation, no progression table |
| `skill_sacrifice.html` | a sacrifice enchantment | sacrifice %, upkeep −1, overcast, `1½` activation, no attribute |
| `skill_special_rounding.html` | a skill with a derived row | a row that breaks the Gr formula |
| `skill_monster.html` | a monster skill | `Monster Monster` box, several campaigns |
| `skill_redirected.html` | a page reached through a redirect | the "Redirected from" marker |
| `foe_basic.html` | an NPC page | several `NM (HM)` level pairs, HM attribute text, `(Hard mode only)`, armor at a level |
| `foe_variants.html` | an NPC page with variants | per-variant skill lists and armor tables |
| `area.html` | an explorable area | Foes groups, Bosses |
| `skill_list.html` | `Skill_template_format/Skill_list` | IDs, a `(PvP)` title, the "No Skill" row |
| `game_integration.html` | a game-integration page | `Skill N → title`, an unused ID, the next-page link |
| `profession_list.html` | "List of mesmer skills" | gold elite cells, "No Attribute" |
| `pve_only_list.html` | "List of PvE-only skills" | |
| `category.html` | a category's first page | |
| `game_update.html` | a game-update page | `(BOTH)`, a `(PvP)` line |

They were generated by a throwaway script. If one needs to change, edit the
HTML directly: it is the fixture, not the script.
